label: Interval-bounded longitudinal braking recoverability slice
not: a claim that human fallback succeeds

success_definition.class_u_brake: MODEL CONDITION (definition of this slice, not evidence)
success_definition.definition: speed reaches zero at least 2.0 m before the stationary obstacle; T_available = TTC at TOR (constant-velocity reference); T_required = (D_stop + 2.0 m) / v0

classification_rule.PARAMETER-SENSITIVE: otherwise (bounds straddle or touch the +-epsilon band)

bound_method: corner evaluation, valid only where the analytic-derivative monotonicity guard passes (fail-closed); not a general constrained-bound search

definitions.monotone_endpoint_bound: corner evaluation inside the guarded monotone domain
definitions.stationary_point_t1_bound: corners of all other (guard-monotone) parameters x {t1 endpoints, interior roots of the exact dT/dt1}

interval_method: exact min/max over all corners of the parameter box; verified by a 4-point-per-dimension interior grid; no distributions

branches.P0|AUTH_AT_EFFECTIVE: automation holds speed (net 0) until authority transfer at effective human braking; equals the legacy W0 pre-control behaviour
branches.P0|AUTH_UNCERTAIN: automation holds speed until authority transfer at f*t1, f in [0, 1]; drag only afterwards
branches.P1: automation ceases propulsion at TOR; drag only until effective braking. Authority timing has no longitudinal effect because both sides of it are drag. Lift-off regen / engine braking excluded, so this is the powertrain-conservative passive case
branches.P2|AUTH_AT_EFFECTIVE: automation applies net deceleration a_sup until effective human braking
branches.P2|AUTH_UNCERTAIN: automation applies a_sup until authority transfer at f*t1, then drag only

blocked_inputs_not_used.j_brake: braking jerk as an independent input (P13)
blocked_inputs_not_used.a_auto_max: ISO 15622 ACC numeric limits (P19, secondary only)
blocked_inputs_not_used.a_liftoff: lift-off regenerative deceleration (P04; excluded, so P1 uses drag only)

validity_envelope: stationary longitudinal hazard fully blocking the ego lane
no usable escape path: braking-only analysis
deterministic point-mass longitudinal approximation (no tyre, load-transfer or ABS dynamics)
full braking command (u = 1) after effective human control: capability bound, not observed human braking
zero acceleration during actuation delay and drag neglected after effective control (conservative)
drag held at its value at v0 during pre-control (slightly optimistic; <= 0.6 m/s2 over <= 3 s)
authority-transfer timing, t1 and t3 are explicit assumptions, not identified from any data
no detailed lateral dynamics and no human steering strategy
no probabilistic driver model; interval bounds are not confidence intervals
no D003 vehicle calibration; D003 values are used only to choose scenario values
no claim about production automated-driving systems; P0/P1/P2 are counterfactual branches
